description_en: Queries the security groups in MediaLive
description_zh: 查询媒体直播输入安全组列表
kebab_example: aliyun ice list-media-live-input-security-groups --max-results 10 --skip 20 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --sort-order desc --keyword 123 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListMediaLiveInputSecurityGroups

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: If you do not specify this parameter or if you set a value smaller than 10, the default value is 10. If you set a value greater than 100, the default value is 100
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。最大值为 100。
默认值：
当不设置值或设置的值小于 10 时，默认值为 10。
当设置的值大于 100 时，默认值为 100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to be skipped in the query. If the number of entries you attempt to skip exceeds the number of entries that meet the condition, an empty list is returned
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时跳过的条目数。
当跳过的条目数超过符合条件的条目总数时，会返回空列表
parameters.name: skip

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次 API 调用返回的NextToken参数值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The sorting order of the security groups by creation time. Default value: asc. Valid values: desc and asc. asc indicates the ascending order, and desc indicates the descending order
parameters.help_zh:
指定查询的排序规则，用于按安全组的创建时间排序。默认是asc。
可选值：desc（降序排序），asc（升序排序）
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: The keyword of the query. You can perform a fuzzy search on security group ID or name
parameters.help_zh: 指定查询的关键词。对安全组ID/名称进行搜索，均支持模糊搜索
parameters.name: keyword

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

NextToken.description_en: A pagination token. It can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results

items.description_en: The information about a security group

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the security group was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreateTime.description_zh: 安全组创建时间，格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（RFC 3339格式），采用 UTC +0 时区

InputIds.description_en: The IDs of the inputs associated with the security group
InputIds.description_zh: 安全组关联的输入ID列表

items.description_en: The input ID associated with the security group

SecurityGroupId.description_en: The ID of the security group

items.description_en: The IPv4 addresses that are allowed to push content to MediaLive

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合分页条件查询的总条目数
